Tower Bridge Advisors increased its stake in Keycorp (KEY) by 1.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tower Bridge Advisors who had been investing in Keycorp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $20.12 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.88% or $0.1662 during the last trading session, reaching $19.1262. About 2.38M shares traded. KeyCorp (NYSE:KEY) has risen 12.17%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.62% the S&P500. 
Tower Bridge Advisors, which manages about $1.11B and $932.33 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 278 shares to 140,485 shares, valued at $23.77B in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) by 3,031 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 193,519 shares, and cut its stake in Comcast Corp New Cl A (NASDAQ:CMCSA).
